attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"the Greywater Concord seems unimpressed","reason":"The briefing gives no Concord reaction to the Choir's inquiries."},{"span":"the argument over archery rules shows no sign of ending","reason":"Old news is presented as an ongoing development with a new status the briefing does not give."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It opens with a copied heading ('News since your last bulletin:'), which breaks the no-headings rule, and the lead item repeats the briefing almost word for word. It also recycles old news as ongoing and invents a Concord reaction and an update on the archery argument; the wit is thin compared with the earlier bulletins."}
